weather_report:
As the day unfolds in Boston, the sky drapes itself in a muted gray, casting a soft blanket over the city. A veil of mist lingers, hinting at the presence of fog that curls around the edges of the horizon. Though warmth flirts with the air — a promise of around 75 degrees — it is accompanied by moisture, with rain showers likely to thread through the morning. The humid breeze from the southeast carries an electric charge, hinting at the dance of droplets that may soon grace the streets. 

The evening may not bring an end to this ceremonial moisture; it lingers as a slight chance of rain lingers even after the sun dips below the skyline. Those brave enough to navigate the world outside today should dress light yet prepared — perhaps favoring a cotton sweater to ward off the coolness of patchy fog, coupled with a pair of water-resistant shoes for any inadvertent splashes. It feels like perfect weather to explore the hidden corners of cozy cafés, where a steaming cup of coffee might offer comfort against the gray backdrop, or perhaps a leisurely stroll along the waterfront will strike a chord with the soul. In a day that invites reflection and pause, embrace the charm hidden within the gentler climes of an overcast afternoon.
